searchText: Also: https://twitter.com/VitalikButerin/status/1301298086027821056?s=19 If we're going into this knowing attacks are possible, wouldn't it be in the best interest of the network to demonstrate that capability? An attack net is great and all, but unless the response to that attack is also being simulated, as opposed to just fixed and move on, it's not the same thing Red Team / Blue Team, not just Red Team 🙂
